_desc: Canned dialogue responses for cascade events - NPC reactions to world events

witness: I saw the whole thing. Happened so fast.
*shaking* They had a weapon. Just took everything.
I'm still processing what I saw.
Someone needs to tell the Temple. This can't keep happening.
victim: They took everything I had on me.
I didn't even see their face.
This city used to be safer.
*visibly shaken* I just want to go home.
bystander_aware: Did you hear? Someone got robbed right over there.
Keep your valuables hidden. Just saying.
Crime's getting worse. Temple doesn't care.
criminal_sympathizer: Not saying it's right, but I understand.
Temple squeezes us, we squeeze each other.

reporter: I had to tell someone. It's not right.
Temple needs to know what happened.
Hope I did the right thing. Just told them what I saw.
neighbor_aware: Someone talked. Temple's going to be asking questions.
Word is there's a witness. Brave or stupid.
I heard someone reported it. Things are about to get complicated.
*whispers* Someone snitched. Keep your head down.

nervous_citizen: *glances around* Best stay out of their way.
They're asking everyone questions. I don't know anything.
cooperative_citizen: I already told them what I know.
Hope they catch whoever did it.
I saw the officers. Good, we need order.
suspicious_citizen: Temple's 'investigating.' Wonder what they're really after.
When they investigate, someone disappears. Watch.
All this for a robbery? They're looking for something else.
*scoffs* Temple investigation. That's code for harassment.

witness_to_arrest: They dragged someone off. Looked rough.
Saw the arrest. Didn't look like they were gentle.
Temple took someone in. Don't know if they were guilty.
family_of_arrested: They took {name}! We have to do something!
*crying* I don't know where they're keeping them.
They're innocent! The Temple doesn't care!
I need to find a way to see them. Please help.
neighbor_reaction: They arrested someone from the building. Crazy.
Never thought it would be them. Seemed normal.
Temple finally got someone. Hope it's the right person.

following_trial: Trial's been going on. Everyone's talking about it.
Temple judges are harsh. Don't expect mercy.
family_at_trial: I was there every day. They didn't listen.
The trial was a joke. Decision was already made.
We're hoping for the best. That's all we can do.
*exhausted* It's finally over. Now we wait.

spreading_gossip: Did you hear what happened? *leans in*
You didn't hear this from me, but...
receiving_gossip: Interesting. I'll keep that in mind.

witness: *traumatized* I saw... I saw them die.
There was so much blood. I can't unsee it.
They didn't even have a chance.
I should have done something. I just froze.
neighbor: Someone was killed right nearby. I can't believe it.
This wasn't supposed to happen here.
Murder? Here? What's happening to this place?
*locked door* I'm not opening for anyone tonight.
general_awareness: Did you hear? Someone was killed.
There was a murder. Temple's all over it now.
Death in the district. Everyone's on edge.
*grim* Another one lost to the streets.

grieving_family: I don't know how to go on without them.
friend_of_family: I'm so sorry for your loss.
Is there anything I can do?
They were good. Didn't deserve this.

believer: Can you believe it? Real music! The Echoes are REAL!
*excited* I heard it too! Like voices from the past!
This proves everything! They can't hide the truth!
The Echoes have returned. The Silence is ending!
skeptic: Another 'Echo sighting.' Right. Probably a hoax.
People hear what they want to hear.
I'll believe it when I hear it myself.
curious: I heard there were... sounds? Music?
Everyone's talking about it. Wish I'd been there.
Makes you wonder what's really out there.
temple_response: Citizens should not approach. Report sightings.
Spreading rumors about 'Echoes' is a violation.
There is no music. The Silence protects us.

fearful_citizen: Stay inside! It's not safe out there!
Don't draw attention. Just blend in.
I'm not leaving until this blows over.
angry_citizen: This is how they keep us down! Violence and fear!
They call this peace? This is oppression!
When did protecting us mean attacking us?
compliant_citizen: The Temple knows best. Those people were troublemakers.
If you follow the rules, you have nothing to fear.
Order must be maintained. Even if it's harsh.
I support the Temple. We need stability.
resistance_view: They're showing their true colors now.
Every crackdown creates more of us.
Remember this moment. Remember who they really are.

participant: For the Echoes! For the truth!
*chanting* No more lies! No more Silence!
supportive_observer: I wish I could be out there with them.
nervous_observer: This is going to end badly. I can feel it.
They're brave, but the Temple won't let this stand.
I support them, but I can't be seen here.
*looks for exit* Temple's coming. I need to go.

noticed_patrols: More guards than usual. Something's up.
Temple's everywhere today. Watch your step.
Increased patrols. Wonder what they're looking for.

complaint: Curfew again? How am I supposed to work?
This is ridiculous. We're not children.
Another curfew. Another excuse to control us.
They take more freedoms every day.
acceptance: If it keeps us safe, I'll manage.
Better a curfew than more crime.
I'll be home before dark anyway.

owner: Couldn't keep it going. The end of an era.
I tried everything. It just wasn't enough.
This place was my life. Now what?
*defeated* Sometimes you can't fight the tide.
employee: Lost my job. Now what am I going to do?
Another business closed. Another line for work.
*worried* I have family depending on me.
customer: Shame about that place. I used to go there.
Where am I supposed to go now?

intent_mappings._desc: Map user questions to event dialogue
